primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.2 Atmospheric Cloud Coverage, printed p.18 / PDF p.33
primary_records.original_meaning: Current cloud coverage represented as a list of Cloud Layer descriptions. A layer requires a category String; optional coverage describes cloud cover, base is altitude above sea level, height is measured from the layer base, and width is angular.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not a cloud-cover percentage, total sky fraction, ground-level visibility or a single mandatory layer. Suggested category/coverage Strings are examples, not a sealed enumeration. Cloud Layer is an Accepted CBRN extension implemented using Custom Types; base and height have different references.
primary_records.related_existing_row_fit: PARTIAL: a typed environmental observable supports a specific reported information role, not a complete reusable observable-property ontology.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.2 Atmospheric Dew Point, printed p.18 / PDF p.33
primary_records.original_meaning: Atmospheric temperature below which water droplets begin to condense and dew can form, represented by Measured Celsius: required value and optional error.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not the current air temperature, device-internal temperature or a freezing threshold. Preserve Celsius and the declared optional measurement error; no site, time, algorithm or manufacturer value is invented. The location fallback stated for the core atmospheric entries is not automatically extended to this entry.
primary_records.related_existing_row_fit: PARTIAL: a typed environmental observable supports a specific reported information role, not a complete reusable observable-property ontology.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.2 Atmospheric Humidity, printed p.18 / PDF p.33
primary_records.original_meaning: Measured humidity at the observation position. The Humidity composite expresses water relative to saturation at a given temperature and pressure with a required Percent value and optional Percent error. If the Position observable is absent, the observable definition uses the observing component position.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not absolute humidity, stored-energy percent or device-internal moisture. The Humidity error field has no one-standard-deviation rule in its own definition; do not silently borrow that rule from Measured Percent. A source fallback is not an authenticated surveyed probe point.
primary_records.related_existing_row_fit: PARTIAL: a typed environmental observable supports a specific reported information role, not a complete reusable observable-property ontology.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.2 Atmospheric Precipitation, printed p.18 / PDF p.33
primary_records.proposed_label: Observed atmospheric precipitation category and rate
primary_records.original_meaning: Current precipitation represented by the Accepted Precipitation composite: a required category String and an optional rate of type Measured Mpsec.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not accumulated rainfall depth, event duration or an inferred interval total. Retain the source rate type in metres per second without inventing a measurement method, accumulation window or drop-fall interpretation. Category suggestions are not a sealed code list; the composite requires Custom Types.
primary_records.related_existing_row_fit: PARTIAL: a typed environmental observable supports a specific reported information role, not a complete reusable observable-property ontology.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.2 Atmospheric Pressure, printed p.18 / PDF p.33
primary_records.original_meaning: Measured atmospheric pressure at the observation position, with the observing component position used if the Position observable is absent. Measured Pascals has a required Pascals value and optional Pascals error.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not a pressure rating or automatically a sea-level-corrected barometric pressure. Preserve pascals and optional error; source units note 100 Pa = 1 hPa = 1 millibar, but no case-specific numerical conversion or source precision is fabricated.
primary_records.related_existing_row_fit: PARTIAL: a typed environmental observable supports a specific reported information role, not a complete reusable observable-property ontology.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.2 Atmospheric Temperature, printed p.18 / PDF p.33
primary_records.original_meaning: Measured atmospheric temperature at the observation position, using the observing component position if the Position observable is absent. Uses Measured Celsius with required value and optional error.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Environmental air temperature is not the separate internal-device Temperature property, logger panel temperature, a design operating limit or an ISA encoding proven for NOAA records. The source supplies no original averaging interval, resultTime or sensor attribution for the four equipment cases.
primary_records.related_existing_row_fit: PARTIAL: a typed environmental observable supports a specific reported information role, not a complete reusable observable-property ontology.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.2 Atmospheric Visibility, printed p.19 / PDF p.34
primary_records.proposed_label: Observed atmospheric visibility condition and distance
primary_records.original_meaning: Current visibility represented by an Accepted Visibility composite: required weather-condition category String and optional maximum visible distance of type Measured Meters.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not the Visible laser-spectrum property, network exposure or camera taskability. Category does not imply a mandatory distance or full clear conditions. Suggested labels remain open Strings; Custom Types are required for this composite.
primary_records.related_existing_row_fit: PARTIAL: a typed environmental observable supports a specific reported information role, not a complete reusable observable-property ontology.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.2 Atmospheric Wind, printed p.19 / PDF p.34
primary_records.proposed_label: Observed atmospheric wind category, speed and direction
primary_records.original_meaning: Measured atmospheric wind at the observation position, defaulting that position to the observing component when the Position observable is absent. Wind requires a Wind Category; speed is optional Measured Mpsec with source default 0, and direction is optional Measured Degrees in the North Oriented, Local-Level (NOLL) x-y frame with default None.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not device Velocity or a mandatory speed/direction pair. An omitted speed with a schema default is not evidence that calm wind was actually measured. Preserve NOLL without inventing a from-versus-toward convention, numerical transformation or a measured direction for None. Wind categories and defaults remain separate.
primary_records.related_existing_row_fit: PARTIAL: a typed environmental observable supports a specific reported information role, not a complete reusable observable-property ontology.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.2 Area, printed p.18 / PDF p.33
primary_records.original_meaning: Absolute position or geographic area associated with the observation, represented by the Geographic Shape union.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not the component's installation position, current View Area, or configured Zones. The union lists Geographic Arc, Geographic Ellipse, Geographic Polygon and Geographic Polyline; despite its introductory point-to-shape wording it does not list a standalone Geographic Position alternative. Do not invent a point-only encoding, polygon-only restriction, CRS conversion or GeoJSON equivalence.
primary_records.related_existing_row_fit: PARTIAL: a specific typed observation-content field supports the generic reported-output-field concept; it is not itself an observing act, physical component or channel.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.2 Bearing, printed p.19 / PDF p.34
primary_records.proposed_label: Observed-entity bearing relative to observer orientation
primary_records.original_meaning: Rotation from the observing component's current orientation to the observed entity. Rotation requires pitch, roll and yaw as Measured Degrees and applies yaw about z, pitch about the new y-prime axis, then roll about the new x-double-prime axis.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not automatically compass azimuth, absolute world orientation, a mounting offset or a new component orientation. Preserve the relative observer-to-entity role and source rotation order; no numeric absolute-frame transform is inferred and existing Orientation question ISA-Q003 is not silently resolved.
primary_records.related_existing_row_fit: PARTIAL: a specific typed observation-content field supports the generic reported-output-field concept; it is not itself an observing act, physical component or channel.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.2 Distance, printed p.20 / PDF p.35
primary_records.original_meaning: Distance from the observing component to the observed entity, represented by required value in meters and optional measurement error.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not expected usable Range, maximum Detection Range, a location coordinate, or proof of detection reliability. No horizontal/slant/geodesic distance convention or source-case value is invented. The type's optional error retains its stated plus-or-minus one-standard-deviation convention; missing error is not zero error.
primary_records.related_existing_row_fit: PARTIAL: a specific typed observation-content field supports the generic reported-output-field concept; it is not itself an observing act, physical component or channel.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.2 Point of Impact, printed p.21 / PDF p.36
primary_records.original_meaning: Absolute position where an entity impacted an object or surface, represented using Geographic Position.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: A source-reported impact location, not the observed entity's current Position, an observer location, a predicted impact point, or a commanded destination. Geographic Position defaults do not prove surveyed altitude or perfect accuracy; no trajectory, causation or timestamp absent from this field is inferred.
primary_records.related_existing_row_fit: PARTIAL: a specific typed observation-content field supports the generic reported-output-field concept; it is not itself an observing act, physical component or channel.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.2 Point of Origin, printed p.21 / PDF p.36
primary_records.original_meaning: Absolute position at which an entity was launched, represented using Geographic Position.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not the coordinate-system origin, network source address, observer installation position, or every possible entity origin. No weapon trajectory or forecast is derived. Preserve the field's launch-location scope and optional geographic metadata without inventing provenance or launch time.
primary_records.related_existing_row_fit: PARTIAL: a specific typed observation-content field supports the generic reported-output-field concept; it is not itself an observing act, physical component or channel.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.2 Position, printed p.21 / PDF p.36
primary_records.original_meaning: Absolute position of the entity at the point at which it was observed, whether by detection or measurement. The source permits visible entities and invisible entities such as a signal or atmosphere.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Distinct from the component Position property, its Perceived Position/Position Override, and a station site coordinate. Geographic Position requires latitude/longitude and permits altitude and error-ellipsoid fields; preserve the source geoid/EGM96 wording and defaults without asserting Cartesian ECEF values, ellipsoidal-height conversion, a verified probe point or zero uncertainty.
primary_records.related_existing_row_fit: PARTIAL: a specific typed observation-content field supports the generic reported-output-field concept; it is not itself an observing act, physical component or channel.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.2 Velocity, printed p.22 / PDF p.37
primary_records.original_meaning: Absolute velocity of the entity at the point at which it was observed. Its composite requires heading (Measured Degrees) in the absolute XY plane and speed (Measured Mpsec); pitch is optional with the source default of zero.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Distinct from component Velocity, atmospheric Wind, angular Rotation Rate or a forecast. Do not substitute speed alone for velocity, treat an omitted pitch default as a measured zero, or invent a reference-frame transformation or sampling interval.
primary_records.related_existing_row_fit: PARTIAL: a specific typed observation-content field supports the generic reported-output-field concept; it is not itself an observing act, physical component or channel.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.2 BSO, printed p.19 / PDF p.34
primary_records.original_meaning: An assigned unique identifier for a confirmed or suspected battlefield entity. BSO ID is a String identifying a unique battle space object.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Identifies the observed entity, not the observing component, its UCI, hardware serial number, the Event ID or the Standard Identity classification. No cross-authority global uniqueness mechanism, mandatory syntax, identity authentication or confirmed real-world existence is established by the cited definition.
primary_records.related_existing_row_fit: PARTIAL: a specific source-defined event-content field supports the generic reported-output-field concept; it does not establish an observing act, physical channel or blanket provenance equivalence.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.2 Comment, printed p.20 / PDF p.35
primary_records.original_meaning: Human-readable commentary about the observation, represented as one String value.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not a structured measured result, machine decision code, component description, author identity, modification history or proof that the comment is correct. The source defines no mandatory comment vocabulary.
primary_records.related_existing_row_fit: PARTIAL: a specific source-defined event-content field supports the generic reported-output-field concept; it does not establish an observing act, physical channel or blanket provenance equivalence.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.2 Event Type Other Reason, printed p.20 / PDF p.35
primary_records.original_meaning: Human-readable reason why this Event used the OTHER Event Type. TEST is a suggested String value, not an exhaustive vocabulary. The separate sealed Event Type enum includes ALARM, ALERT, DETECTION, MEASUREMENT and OTHER.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Retain its Accepted-extension status. An explanatory String does not add a new member to the sealed Event Type enum, establish a test was actually performed, or substitute for the event-generation method or a quality flag.
primary_records.related_existing_row_fit: PARTIAL: a specific source-defined event-content field supports the generic reported-output-field concept; it does not establish an observing act, physical channel or blanket provenance equivalence.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.2 Identity, printed p.20 / PDF p.35
primary_records.proposed_label: Reported tactical identity of observed entity
primary_records.original_meaning: Standardized descriptive identity of the observed entity using Standard Identity: a required SIDC symbol and optional confidence percentage. The composite references MIL-STD-2525C, supplies default symbol SU*P------*****, and documents optional confidence default100 plus high/medium/low mappings of90/66/33 percent.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: This is symbolic/tactical classification, not the unique BSO ID, component UCI, serial number, login or cryptographic identity. Preserve required-field/default wording without claiming an omitted symbol was transmitted. Default confidence100 is not measured certainty; the source mapping is specific to Standard Identity, not a universal conversion for other confidence or quality fields. Do not replace the cited SIDC edition with another code system.
primary_records.related_existing_row_fit: PARTIAL: a specific source-defined event-content field supports the generic reported-output-field concept; it does not establish an observing act, physical channel or blanket provenance equivalence.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.2 Media, printed p.20 / PDF p.35
primary_records.original_meaning: A list of descriptors for resources generated for, or otherwise relevant to, the observation; examples include video, audio, images, text and raw data. Each descriptor requires resource type and URL, permits title/created/lastmod, and retains a required zero-or-more metadata list. Resource Type requires primary and secondary strings and a zero-or-more parameters list.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not the component Resources catalogue, physical equipment inventory, inline payload, measurement schema or proof the URL is reachable or authenticated. Resource creation/modification times are not automatically observation phenomenonTime or resultTime. A resource may be relevant without being generated by the observing component. Preserve metadata/parameter typing and source subtype defaults; do not invent provenance, media contents or equipment links.
primary_records.related_existing_row_fit: PARTIAL: a specific source-defined event-content field supports the generic reported-output-field concept; it does not establish an observing act, physical channel or blanket provenance equivalence.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.2 Method, printed p.20 / PDF p.35
primary_records.original_meaning: The primary method used to generate the event, expressed as a String. Source suggestions include MANUAL, ATR_V, ATR_T, MAGNETIC, ACOUSTIC, FUSION, RADAR and LIDAR.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Retain Accepted-extension standing and an open String: the suggestions are not a sealed enum. A reported method label does not define an executable algorithm, reusable observing procedure, configured component capability, authenticated performer or complete processing/provenance chain.
primary_records.related_existing_row_fit: PARTIAL: a specific source-defined event-content field supports the generic reported-output-field concept; it does not establish an observing act, physical channel or blanket provenance equivalence.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.2 Verified By, printed p.22 / PDF p.37
primary_records.original_meaning: Identity of the person who verified the accuracy of the contents of the containing Event message, represented as a String.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Attribution is not a digital signature, certificate, role/permission, verification timestamp, described checking procedure, independent accuracy assessment or authenticated proof. Do not infer a machine UCI, quality-control code or completed external certification from a person-name field.
primary_records.related_existing_row_fit: PARTIAL: a specific source-defined event-content field supports the generic reported-output-field concept; it does not establish an observing act, physical channel or blanket provenance equivalence.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Cloud Layer, printed p.90, PDF 105–106
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required category:String1; optional coverage:String0–1, base:Measured Meters0–1 above sea level, height:Measured Meters0–1 from the base, width:Measured Degrees0–1 on continued PDF106. Suggested categories/coverage not sealed enums. Accepted CBRN composite expressly not standard and constructed using Custom Types.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Humidity, printed p.95, PDF 110–111
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required value:Percent1; optional error:Percent0–1. Definition is a ratio relative to saturation at given temperature/pressure; no confidence convention stated for its error field. Heading on PDF110, fields on PDF111.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Precipitation, printed p.107, PDF 122–122
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required category:String1 with suggested precipitation categories; optional rate:Measured Mpsec0–1. Preserve actual source unit/type, not guessed accumulation or method. Accepted CBRN composite, not standard; requires Custom Types.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Visibility, printed p.115, PDF 130–130
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required category:String1 describes weather affecting visibility; optional distance:Measured Meters0–1 is maximum distance considered visible. Suggested labels not sealed. Accepted CBRN composite requires Custom Types.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Wind, printed p.116, PDF 131–132
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required category:Wind Category1; optional speed:Measured Mpsec0–1 with source default0; optional direction:Measured Degrees0–1 in NOLL x-y plane with default None. Defaults are not recorded measurements; direction sense or conversion not invented.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.1 Wind Category, printed p.83, PDF 98–99
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Complete unsealed enumeration across PDF98–99: CONSTANT, EXTREME TURBULENCE, GUST, LIGHT TURBULENCE, MODERATE TURBULENCE, SEVERE TURBULENCE, SQUALL, UNKNOWN, UNSPECIFIED, VARIABLE. UNKNOWN denotes inconclusive categorization; UNSPECIFIED denotes no attempt. Preserve the source VARIABLE criteria (two-minute evaluation; 6-knot and 60-degree conditions) without using the interval as universal sampling cadence.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Pascals, printed p.54, PDF 69–69
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Float force per area, units pascals (N/m²), declared range (-inf,inf); source states100Pa =1hPa =1millibar. Do not add a source-absent domain constraint or convert case values.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Measured Pascals, printed p.102, PDF 117–118
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required value:Pascals1 on PDF117 and optional error:Pascals0–1 on PDF118. Error expressed as plus/minus one standard deviation. An absent error is not zero uncertainty.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Geographic Arc, printed p.94, PDF 109–109
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required position:Geographic Position1, radius:Measured Meters1, centerline:Measured Degrees1 and arc angle:Measured Degrees1. Centerline is north-oriented, zero north; arc angle spans either side of that centerline. Preserve arc/circumference semantics, not a silently filled polygon sector.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Geographic Ellipse, printed p.94, PDF 109–109
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required center:Geographic Position1 and ellipsoid:Ellipsoid1. Source combines a geographic center with a three-dimensional ellipsoid definition; do not flatten it automatically to a planar ellipse.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Geographic Polyline, printed p.95, PDF 110–110
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required points:Geographic Position list2+, traversed in order. The definition does not state polygon closure or require the last point to repeat the first.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Ellipsoid, printed p.92, PDF 107–108
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required a:Measured Meters1; optional b and c:Measured Meters0–1 default to a; optional phi and theta:Measured Degrees0–1 default0.0, with source northing/vertical-relative orientation descriptions. Read continuation on PDF108. Distinct from Geographic Position's optional raw-Meters uncertainty fields; do not assume the shape represents measurement uncertainty.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 BSO ID, printed p.51, PDF 66–66
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Scalar String identifying a unique battle space object, standard since6.0. The definition supplies no additional range, unit, syntax, issuer or global reconciliation rule.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.1 Event Type, printed p.79, PDF 94–94
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Sealed enumeration, standard since6.0: ALARM (property criteria), ALERT (measurement/detection criteria), DETECTION (identified presence), MEASUREMENT (requested observation, including timer request), OTHER (reason not otherwise provided). The separate Accepted OTHER-reason String does not extend this enum.

case_checks: Dragino SHT31 temperature/humidity reference capability does not prove native ISA environmental messages, installed observation position or quality values.
AirGradient reference particulate hardware and output properties do not imply these atmospheric quantities or values were measured via ISA.
Campbell ClimaVue environmental fields remain separate from logger Status.PanelTemp; no native ISA encoding or fielded installation inferred.

Bennett original ATemp mean events concern ambient air, not ISA internal Temperature; exact original resultTime, producer attribution and probe position remain unchanged. No new equipment values were added.
mapping_note: Twenty-two reviewed observables now support explicit atmospheric, spatial and event-context information roles. BSO entity identifier, tactical Identity, free-text context, event-associated Media and verifier attribution remain distinct. These are traceable candidate information rows, not automatic adopted DIM requirements; aggregate-row reconciliation remains assigned.

checks: No original equipment or donor display value changed; geographic observables do not turn reference-design specifications into installed ISA outputs.

Bennett station coordinates and probe serial identities do not establish observed-entity position, impact/origin location or exact sensor placement. Existing two source means/four representations and unknown original resultTime remain unchanged.

Component Position/Velocity and Orientation properties stay distinct from observed-entity Position/Velocity and relative Bearing. View Area and Zones remain component-facing spatial roles, not replacements for Area.
The four source cases retain all existing values and evidence status; none is assigned an invented BSO ID, tactical classification, verifier, event-generation method or live media URL.

Bennett serials/station ID and source QA tokens do not establish a BSO ID or authenticated Verified By attribution. Two original NOAA means/four digital representations and unknown original resultTime remain unchanged.
Component Identity and Resources property meanings stay distinct from observed-entity Identity and event-associated Media; no other donor correspondence was added.
